label: Csvbox
description: Manage sheets, import columns, destinations, validation and transforms

operations.name: list_sheets
operations.description: List one page of sheets owned by the API user; use page to continue.

operations.name: get_sheet
operations.description: Read a sheet's columns, scripts and importer settings.

operations.name: create_sheet
operations.description: Create a sheet importer. Every supplied script item is created.

operations.name: update_sheet
operations.description: PUT updates supplied fields. Supplied script collections replace stored collections: omitted items are deleted, and [] clears the collection.

operations.name: patch_sheet
operations.description: PATCH changes only supplied fields. Script collections merge named items; [] is a no-op and _delete removes a named item.

operations.name: set_sheet_columns
operations.description: Set the sheet's column definitions and built-in validation rules.

operations.name: set_destinations
operations.description: Configure the destination receiving imported rows.

operations.name: set_import_steps
operations.description: Configure upload, mapping, verification and result-screen settings.

operations.name: set_security_settings
operations.description: Configure region, allowed domains and upload security settings.

operations.name: merge_virtual_columns
operations.description: Merge computed columns by column_name; _delete removes one and [] is a no-op.

operations.name: merge_validation_functions
operations.description: Merge validators by function_name. Omitted code and scope fields are preserved on existing items; _delete removes one.

operations.name: merge_data_transforms
operations.description: Merge transforms by transform_name. Omitted fields are preserved on existing items; _delete removes one.

operations.name: set_pdf_metadata
operations.description: Replace the PDF/DOCX metadata extraction configuration; [] clears it.
